battle.name: 襄陽之戰
battle.brief: 嘉定十年（1217）正月，蒙古軍自河南南下，直趨荊襄門戶襄陽與隔漢水相望的樊城，築長圍合攻，至嘉定十二年因主力西征解圍。宋以趙葵、孟宗政守城，屢以弩砲與夜襲破敵營。卡面的配重投石車在蒙古攻城序列中砸擊城牆與城頭守軍，同撞車、雲梯併用，襄陽未陷，圍城已預演日後元軍再攻襄樊的辦法。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 襄陽之戰指嘉定九年末至嘉定十二年（1216年末至1219年）蒙古帝國對南宋荊湖路襄陽、樊城所發動的圍城戰役。交戰一方是蒙古帝國：成吉思汗仍在大汗之位，1216年起由木華黎總攝漢地軍事，在晉、冀、魯、豫一線推進；蒙古本部騎兵之外，大量依靠1211年野狐嶺戰役前後編成並在河北山東收編的真定等處漢軍與探馬赤，並徵發河北、河南的攻城工匠、投石手與輜重畜力。1216至1219年蒙古三次進攻西夏，1219年又籌備西征花剌子模，主力調度備受牽制，這是圍城最終中止的關鍵背景。另一方是南宋：寧宗趙擴在位，荊湖北路的實際軍政由荊襄制置司與安撫司掌握，襄陽為知府治所，樊城是隔漢水北岸的堡塞，與襄陽互為犄角。守軍主力是襄樊兩城的禁軍、廂軍與民兵，糧食由江陵、鄂州沿漢水溯流北運，另有江陵與四川方向的援軍入規。1214至1215年蒙古第一次南侵至長江而敗退後，宋廷仍以荊襄作為屏蔽江漢的門戶，加築城壘、儲糧練兵，與河北、山東已失的情形形成強烈對比。
countriesEn: The Siege of Xiangyang refers to the campaign the Mongol Empire mounted against the Southern Song prefectures of Xiangyang and Fancheng in Jinghu circuit, from the end of the Jiading era to the twelfth year of that era, that is from the end of 1216 to 1219. On one side stood the Mongol Empire: Genghis Khan was still on the throne, and from 1216 the Chinese lands campaign was overseen by J̌urmagan, who pressed forward along the Jin, Ji, Lu and Yu lines; alongside the Mongol native cavalry the Mongols leaned heavily on Han Chinese units raised or surrendered in Zhending and elsewhere in Hebei and Shandong after the Battle of Yehuling in 1211, on the frontier reconnaissance and garrison troops known as tanmači, and on engineers, artillery crews and draught animals requisitioned in Hebei and Henan. Between 1216 and 1219 the Mongols campaigned against Western Xia three times, and in 1219 they began preparing the expedition against Khwarazm, which tied down their main body of troops and is the key background to the lifting of the siege. The other side was the Southern Song: Emperor Ningzong Zhao Kuang was on the throne, and the real military and civil administration of Jinghu circuit lay with the Jingxiang military command and the pacification commission. Xiangyang was the seat of the prefectural governor, while Fancheng was a fort on the far bank of the Han River, serving as the mutual support of Xiangyang. The garrison consisted mainly of imperial guards, provincial troops and militia drawn from the two cities; grain moved up the Han River from Jiangling and Ezhou, and reinforcements entered the theatre from Jiangling and from Sichuan. After the Mongols' first invasion of 1214 and 1215 was turned back on the Yangtze, the Song court still treated Jingxiang as the gateway that shielded the middle Yangtze, adding to the walls, storing grain and drilling troops, in sharp contrast to Hebei and Shandong, which were already lost.
people: 關鍵人物方面，宋方以荊襄制置副使趙方及其子趙葵為核心。趙方在任期間經營荊襄，修城儲糧、招集流亡，把襄樊從一座邊防州治變成可以久守的堡塞，1217年（嘉定十年）他在襄陽病逝，臨終仍以襄樊防務為念；趙葵接掌荊湖安撫事，與孟宗政共守襄樊，多次遣精兵夜出襲營，把守城的士氣撐到圍城最緊的年份。孟宗政是這次圍城最能打的宋將，他先知隨州，招集流民練兵成軍，以精騎與步卒配合屢挫蒙古前鋒，後來出任知襄陽府，主持城防諸事，蒙古軍屢攻不克，士論稱他守隨、襄兩地而敵畏之。蒙古一方，1216至1219年的對宋戰役由木華黎統籌，其部將與漢地降將分任各路，攻城序列中的砲手、撞車手與工匠多由受徵的漢人與色目技術人員充任；成吉思汗把襄樊列為打通江漢、南下江南的關鍵目標，卻沒有留在城下指揮。蒙古的進攻雖在局部得手，卻因西夏戰事與西征籌備而無法長期屯兵城下，反映此時蒙古尚無持久圍攻的制度與補給經驗。宋廷方面，寧宗朝中對宋金、對蒙古的主戰與主和之爭不斷，荊襄的守將只能在資源有限的條件下自行周旋。
peopleEn: On the Song side the leadership centred on the Jingxiang deputy military commissioner Zhao Fang and his son Zhao Kui. While in office Zhao Fang administered Jingxiang, repairing the walls, storing grain and gathering the displaced, and turned Xiangyang and Fancheng from a frontier prefecture into a pair of forts that could be held for a long time; in 1217, the tenth year of Jiading, he died of illness at Xiangyang, with the defence of Xiangyang and Fancheng still on his mind. Zhao Kui took over the pacification of Jinghu, and together with Meng Zongzheng held Xiangyang and Fancheng, repeatedly sending picked troops out at night to strike the Mongol camp and keep the garrison's morale through the hardest years of the siege. Meng Zongzheng was the ablest Song commander in this campaign: as governor of Suizhou he first collected the displaced and trained them into a real force, breaking the Mongol vanguard repeatedly with cavalry and foot working together, and he later took charge of Xiangyang prefecture and ran its defences; the Mongols failed repeatedly before him, and the soldiers of the region spoke of how the enemy feared Suizhou and Xiangyang. On the Mongol side the Song campaign of 1216 to 1219 was directed by J̌urmagan, whose subordinates and surrendered Han Chinese commanders took charge of the several columns, with artillery crews, ram crews and engineers largely drawn from requisitioned Han Chinese and Semu technicians; Genghis Khan named Xiangyang and Fancheng as the key objectives for opening the middle Yangtze and driving on to the south, yet he did not stay before the walls to direct the siege himself. The Mongol attacks won local success, but the Western Xia war and the preparations for the westward expedition prevented them from keeping a large force permanently under the walls, showing that the Mongols at this time had neither the institutions nor the supply system for a protracted siege. At the Song court the alternation between war and peace factions over the Jin and the Mongols never settled, so the commanders of Jingxiang had to improvise within very limited resources.
kits: 卡面兵器是配重投石車（Trebuchet）。這類器械在十三世紀已隨蒙古的西征與漢地工匠流入歐亞戰場，蒙古軍攻城時以長臂配重把石彈甩出，專打城牆、門樓、角樓、馬面與城頭守軍所在的高處目標，是把攻城從壕溝與圍牆推向城頭的第一波火力。實際的攻城序列裡，配重投石車與撞車、雲梯、望車、巢車配合使用：砲石先削城樓與牆面，撞車撞門破扉，雲梯同時靠牆，穴地與攻地道則在牆根作業。除投射武器外，蒙古軍還以牛皮或氈製的帳幕抵禦弩矢，用遮蔽器具保護搬石與填壕的役夫；宋軍則以強弩、弓矢、石砲回擊，兼用火藥兵器如霹靂炮、毒火球與火油焚燒敵人攻具，壕溝前布鹿角、拒馬，城內儲備擂木、滾木與礪石，準備封堵破口。運輸方面，蒙古以馬、驢、騾馱載石料與糧秣，靠驛站與徵發維持千里之外的補給；宋方糧食由江陵、鄂州經漢水船運北運，襄樊之間靠舟楫與浮橋連繫，漢水航運成為圍城期最緊要的一條線。附帶一提，1270年代元軍再攻襄陽時使用的回回炮是更大型的攻城砲，屬於另一場戰役的器械，不在本篇這次圍城所用武器的範圍之內。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet. By the thirteenth century such machines had already travelled across Eurasia with the Mongol campaigns and the craftsmen of Han China. The Mongol besiegers used the long throwing arm and its counterweight to lob stone at the curtain wall, the gate towers, the corner towers, the horse-face defences and the high positions where the defenders stood, and it was this first wave of firepower that lifted siege fighting out of the moat and up onto the wallhead. In practice the trebuchet worked in a sequence together with battering rams, scaling ladders, observation towers and siege towers: stone stripped the towers and the wall face, rams struck the gates, ladders went up at the same moment, and sapping and mining worked at the foot of the wall. Beyond the missile weapons the Mongols covered the crews carrying stone and filling the ditch with hide or felt mantlets, and used screens to shield the labour of the assault. The Song answered with strong crossbows, bows, stone throwers, and with gunpowder weapons such as the thunder-crash bomb, poison fire balls and fire oil used against enemy assault gear, while thorn barriers and cheval-de-frise were planted in front of the ditch and inside the walls were kept beams, logs and stones ready to plug any breach. For supply the Mongols packed stone and grain onto horses, donkeys and mules and maintained a line of depots and levies across a thousand li; the Song drew grain from Jiangling and Ezhou by boat up the Han River, and kept Xiangyang and Fancheng linked by light craft and floating bridges, which made Han River navigation the most critical artery of the siege. It should be added that the huihui pao, the great counterweight siege cannon the Yuan used against Xiangyang in the 1270s, belonged to a different campaign and is not among the weapons deployed in this siege described here.
tactics: 蒙古的攻城邏輯是先遠後近：先用配重投石車與弓砲在城外遠處拋射，壓制城頭、摧毀女牆與樓櫃，再以步卒散兵散佈於壕溝外，填土平壕、拔鹿角、塞城門，同時分兵斷絕襄樊兩岸的水陸連絡，試圖使宋軍無法互相策應。合圍之後，蒙古以營壘環列、壘石為城、長圍相望，逐步把野戰攻城轉成消耗戰；兵鋒先集中在樊城，因樊城牆體較舊、地勢貼水而便於架砲與填壕，襄陽城堅且居高，須待樊城告破再圖。蒙古還屢以夜襲、假退、聲東擊西來疲敵，兵鋒配合雲梯偷攀。守城一方採取閉門不出、以逸待勞的原則：宋軍不與蒙軍在野外交鋒，把精銳留作夜襲的反擊主力，出城時延燒敵營與攻城器械，歸城後立刻封閉缺口；城頭以弩砲壓制接近的蒙軍，專打填壕的役夫與扛梯的兵卒；對攀城之敵則用擂木、滾木壓斃，配合石砲與弓弩封鎖射界。水陸方面，宋以漢水船隊夜渡出奇、護運糧秣，蒙古則設法以木柵、浮壘與封鎖河口削弱這條補給線。雙方的攻防本質上是一場工程與耐力的競賽：配重投石車的射程與破壞力決定了進攻方能把兵推到多近，也決定守方必須把城頭修補得有多快。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method was to engage at a distance first. Trebuchets and bows were worked from far out beyond the ditch, pressing the wallhead and crushing the parapet and towers; then loose infantry spread along the ditch to fill it level, pull out the thorn barriers and block the gates, while other columns were detached to cut the land and water links between the two cities so that the Song could not support one bank from the other. Once the investment was complete the Mongols ringed their camps, built their positions up with stone and ran a long circumvallation, turning a field action into a war of attrition. The weight of the assault fell first on Fancheng, because its older wall sat close against the water, which made it easy to site artillery and to fill the ditch; Xiangyang, taller and harder, could only be taken after Fancheng had fallen. The Mongols also wore the defenders down with night attacks, feigned retreats and feints in two directions, troops going up on ladders while the defenders' eyes were fixed elsewhere. The Song followed a policy of shutting the gates and waiting, fighting no pitched battle in the open: they kept their best troops for night counterattacks, burning the enemy camp and its assault gear before falling back and sealing the breach at once; from the walls strong crossbows covered the approaches, picking off the men filling the ditch and carrying the ladders; those who reached the wall were crushed under beams and logs while stone throwers and bowmen sealed the firing lanes. On the water, Song boats crossed the Han at night to surprise the enemy and to escort grain, while the Mongols tried to weaken that supply line with timber fences, floating barriers and closures of the river mouth. Underneath it all was a contest of engineering and endurance: the range and destructive power of the counterweight trebuchet decided how close the attackers could bring their men, and equally how fast the defenders had to repair the wallhead.
data: 可考的數字有限，須小心對待。圍城自嘉定九年十二月蒙古軍進抵樊城北、嘉定十年正月正式合圍起，至嘉定十二年蒙古撤圍，前後歷時約兩年，若計入前哨戰與斷續進攻，可說跨越三年（1216年末至1219年）。襄陽與樊城隔漢水相望，水路不過數里，卻因浮橋與舟楫受制而難以互相接應；宋代襄陽城周長約十餘里，樊城規模較小，卻正壓在通向襄陽的渡口與橋梁上，因此是蒙古先攻的目標。蒙古每次進攻前集結的兵力以萬計，木華黎在晉、冀、魯、豫一線同時經營的總兵力更大，但史籍對每次攻襄的具體兵數記載混亂，無法給出可靠數字，較可靠的說法是攻城一次可投入數千至數萬人，用以填壕、搬石、扛梯與操砲。守軍方面，襄樊兩城的官軍為數千人量級，另有民兵與各地援軍集結，糧食靠江陵、鄂州沿漢水船運北運，倉儲與民力都難以長期承受高強度圍攻。宋軍曾多次夜襲蒙古營寨並毀其攻城器械，說明圍城陣地並非無懈可擊。蒙古撤退的直接原因是1219年成吉思汗籌備西征花剌子模、西夏戰事尚未了結，主力不能久滯中國南方；同期蒙古軍曾向河南深入，一度抵達汴京一帶，1219年初退去。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are limited and have to be handled with care. The siege runs from the twelfth month of the ninth Jiading year, when the Mongol army reached the north of Fancheng, and the formal investment in the first month of the tenth year, to the Mongol withdrawal in the twelfth year, roughly two years, or three if the outposts and the intermittent attacks are counted, that is from the end of 1216 to 1219. Xiangyang and Fancheng face each other across the Han River, only a few li apart on the water, yet they could hardly support one another because the floating bridges and the boats were at the disposal of the enemy. The Song walls of Xiangyang measured a little over ten li in circuit; Fancheng was smaller, but it sat astride the ford and the bridges leading to Xiangyang, which is why the Mongols struck it first. The force the Mongols gathered before each assault numbered in the thousands and tens of thousands, and the total they handled along the Jin, Ji, Lu and Yu lines under J̌urmagan was larger still, but the records are confused about the exact strength of each attack on Xiangyang and no reliable figure can be given; the safer statement is that a few thousand to some ten thousand men were employed on an assault, filling the ditch, carrying stone, bringing up ladders and serving the artillery. On the Song side the regular garrison in the two cities numbered in the low thousands, supplemented by militia and contingents summoned from the surrounding prefectures; grain came up the Han River by boat from Jiangling and Ezhou, and neither the granaries nor the manpower of the region could long sustain a siege of that intensity. The Song repeatedly attacked the Mongol camp by night and destroyed its assault gear, which shows the investment was not invulnerable. The immediate reason for the Mongol withdrawal was that in 1219 Genghis Khan was preparing the expedition against Khwarazm while the war with Western Xia was still unfinished, and the main body of the army could not be stationed long in southern China; in the same period the Mongols drove deep into Henan, reached the neighbourhood of Bianjing, and withdrew again in early 1219.
cause: 起因有遠近兩層。遠層是蒙古帝國在西征中亞與西夏之前，先要解決南面的漢地：1211年野狐嶺一戰重創金軍後，河北、山東、河南大片州縣淪陷，蒙古得地而不得人心，需要糧源、馬匹、織造與人口，這就要求打通從中原通向江南的運輸線，而襄陽正是江漢與中原之間的鎖鑰，佔據襄樊，漢水可通江陵、武昌，荊湖的糧賦與四川的援軍都在掌握；蒙古同時要迫使南宋議和，用以交換北方的俘虜與牧地。近層是1214至1215年蒙古第一次南侵雖被宋軍在江淮與四川擊退，卻也暴露宋軍在河南、江北的空洞，木華黎1216年起重整河南、河東與山東戰線，把進攻的鋒刃轉向荊湖。西夏是另一條牽線：西夏拒絕向蒙古稱臣，1216至1219年蒙古三次征西夏，兵馬與糧秣大量調往河西，1219年又要籌備對花剌子模的遠征，襄陽之圍因此成了一場既要速戰速決、又無法速戰速決的戰役。南宋方面也有內在弱點：北方流民大批湧入荊襄，軍糧與民力吃緊；朝中主戰與主和之爭不斷，寧宗朝廷既無力北伐，也不敢斷然拒和，結果既不能以主力增援襄樊，又不能以妥協換取太平。
causeEn: The causes work at two distances. In the background, before the campaigns into Central Asia and against Western Xia, the Mongol Empire first had to settle the lands to the south: after the Battle of Yehuling in 1211 shattered the Jin army, large parts of Hebei, Shandong and Henan fell away, and the Mongols had territory without the people to work it, so they needed grain, horses, cloth and subjects, which meant opening a supply line from the central plain into the Yangtze south. Xiangyang was the lock between the middle Yangtze and the plain; hold Xiangyang and Fancheng and the Han River carried the grain tribute of Jinghu and the reinforcements from Sichuan, and the Mongols also expected a negotiated peace with the Song in which the prisoners and the pastures of the north could be bargained for. Closer at hand, the first Mongol invasion of 1214 and 1215 was beaten back by Song troops in the Jianghuai and in Sichuan, but it exposed how hollow the Song positions were in Henan and north of the Yangtze, and from 1216 J̌urmagan reorganised the Henan, Hedong and Shandong fronts and turned the point of the advance towards Jinghu. Western Xia formed a second set of wires: Xia refused to acknowledge the Mongol overlord, and between 1216 and 1219 the Mongols campaigned against it three times, shifting troops and grain westward to the Hexi corridor, while 1219 demanded the preparations for the expedition against Khwarazm. The siege of Xiangyang was therefore a battle that had to be won quickly and could not be. The Song had weaknesses of its own: refugees from the north poured into Jingxiang by the hundred thousand, straining the military granaries and the manpower of the region, and the court alternated between the war and peace factions, too weak to counterattack north yet unwilling to refuse terms outright, so it could neither send a main force to relieve Xiangyang nor buy a peace with concessions.
impact: 直接結果是襄樊未失，荊襄門戶仍在宋手，蒙古未能打開南下長江的通道，因此1230年代之前，蒙古對宋的主要打擊仍集中在兩淮、山東與四川。間接影響更長遠：這次圍城是蒙古第一次完整實施遠程砲火壓制、長圍合壘、分斷水陸、再攻堡寨的攻城流程，等於一次野外的攻城工程實驗；蒙古自此更加倚重配重投石車這類能跨越城牆的火力，也更加注意徵用漢地與西域的攻城工匠與攻城物資，這套做法在六十年後元軍再攻襄陽、襄陽陷落時被推到成熟，說明1217年的圍城是後來那場滅國之戰的雛形與預演。對南宋而言，襄樊之守強化了上游屏障的戰略信仰，荊襄的民兵體制、城防器械儲備與軍民一體的守城方法在趙葵、孟宗政手上成形，之後端平、嘉熙年間孟珙收復荊北，以及賈似道主持的襄樊防務，都建立在此經驗之上。另一個代價是消耗：圍城三年，荊襄的糧價、民力與工匠大量耗用，北方南下的流民問題更加嚴重，朝廷在財政與兵源上的餘地愈來愈窄；士氣卻因守城成功而高估了防守能力，士大夫普遍認為襄陽不可失，卻沒有為襄陽的失守預留任何方案。這種盲目自信，正是1273年樊城淪陷、呂文德投降之後南宋迅速崩潰的心理前提。
impactEn: The immediate result was that Xiangyang and Fancheng were not taken. The gateway of Jingxiang stayed in Song hands, the Mongols did not open a road down the Yangtze, and until the 1230s their main blows against the Song continued to fall on the Two Huai, on Shandong and on Sichuan. The indirect consequences lasted longer. This siege was the first time the Mongols put into practice the full sequence of siege — long range artillery suppression, a closed ring of camps, the cutting of the land and water links, and then the assault on the forts — and it was effectively an open-air trial of siege engineering. From then on the Mongols relied more heavily on counterweight trebuchets, which could throw over a wall, and paid more attention to requisitioning craftsmen and materials from Han China and Central Asia. That practice was brought to maturity sixty years later when the Yuan army returned to Xiangyang and the city fell, so the siege of 1217 was the embryo and the rehearsal of the war that destroyed the dynasty. For the Song, holding Xiangyang strengthened the strategic faith in the upstream shield: the militia system of Jingxiang, the storage of siege equipment and the idea of a city defended by soldiers and people together took shape in the hands of Zhao Kui and Meng Zongzheng, and were the basis for Meng Gong's recovery of northern Jinghu in the Duanping and Jiaxi years and for the Xiangyang defence later directed by Jia Sidao. The other price was exhaustion. Three years of siege consumed the grain prices, the manpower and the craftsmen of Jingxiang, and the refugee question from the north grew worse, while the court's margin in revenue and recruitment narrowed. Morale, however, was inflated by the success, and the scholar class grew confident that Xiangyang could never be lost, without ever devising a plan for the day it was. That confidence was the psychological precondition for the rapid collapse of the Southern Song once Fancheng fell in 1273 and Lü Wende surrendered.
result: 結果是蒙古沒有打下襄陽。嘉定十二年（1219）蒙古主力因西夏與西域的戰事需要，自荊北與河南方向撤出，圍城解除，樊城、襄陽與漢水流域回到宋軍之手，趙葵、孟宗政等守將因守城有功加官晉爵，宋廷在嘉定至寶祐之間數十年得以倚荊襄為上游屏藩。這是一場典型的守住即等於勝利的戰役：雙方都知道蒙古再來只是遲早的事，1217至1219年的圍城沒有解決任何根本問題，既沒有奪取襄陽，也沒有換來和議，蒙古把戰略重心轉向西域，宋廷則把希望寄託在城牆與守將身上。從器械史的角度看，這場戰爭也標定了配重投石車在蒙古軍攻城序列中的位置，它是遠程火力的一環，與撞車、雲梯分工，決定的是能不能把兵送上城頭而不是能不能破門，真正讓襄陽最終陷落的，是1270年代更大型、更精確的火砲技術與指揮體系，以及守方內部的崩潰。史籍對本次圍城的細節記載殘缺，多靠《宋史·趙方傳》《孟宗政傳》與《續資治通鑑》殘卷互證，數字與日期多有出入，但三年圍城、襄陽未陷、蒙古西撤這條主線是清楚的。
resultEn: The Mongols did not take Xiangyang. In the twelfth year of Jiading, 1219, their main body needed elsewhere for the wars against Western Xia and the west, drew out of northern Jinghu and Henan, and the siege was lifted; Fancheng, Xiangyang and the Han valley returned to the Song, and commanders such as Zhao Kui and Meng Zongzheng were promoted for holding the city, so that the Song court could rely on Jingxiang as its upstream shield for the decades between Jiading and Baoyou. It was a typical case of holding being tantamount to victory: both sides knew the Mongols would return, and the siege of 1217 to 1219 settled nothing fundamental. It won no city and bought no peace; the Mongols turned their strategic attention westward, and the Song pinned its hopes on the walls and on the commanders. From the point of view of the history of weapons, the campaign also fixed the place of the counterweight trebuchet in the Mongol siege order: it was one part of the long range firepower, working in division with rams and ladders, and it decided whether troops could be put up on the wallhead rather than whether the gate would break. What finally took Xiangyang was the larger and more accurate artillery of the 1270s, the command system that went with it, and the collapse of the defenders from within. The detailed record of this siege is fragmentary and has to be reconstructed from the biographies of Zhao Fang and Meng Zongzheng in the History of Song and the surviving text of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian, and the numbers and dates differ between sources; the main line, however, is clear enough: three years of siege, Xiangyang not taken, the Mongols withdrawing west.
